title: Daily Report regression fix: correct per-day rendering, reliable dialog scrolling, and accurate period summary

requirements.summary: Render the Daily Report as one card per distinct calendar day with pickups (no incorrect dedup/collapse), sorted chronologically.
acceptanceCriteria: Given imported data containing pickups on multiple distinct dates within the selected range, the Daily Report displays a separate daily breakdown card for each date that has pickups.
The Daily Report does not display any days that have zero pickups in the selected range.
Daily breakdown cards are sorted chronologically by date.

The UI does not use a deduplication strategy that can incorrectly drop legitimate days (e.g., if the backend already aggregates by day, the frontend should render the returned days as-is; if dedup is still needed, it must not collapse distinct days).

file_operations.description: Remove/replace the current Map-based deduplication keyed by daily.date (which can collapse multiple days). Instead, render the backend-returned daily totals as-is (no dedup), then apply: (1) filter to only days with data (non-zero totals), and (2) stable chronological sort by date. Ensure each rendered card key is unique per day (e.g., the day timestamp string).

requirements.summary: Make the Daily Report dialog reliably scrollable on desktop and mobile so all day cards and the summary are reachable.
acceptanceCriteria: With enough daily breakdown cards to exceed the dialog height, users can scroll within the Daily Report dialog to view all days and the summary.
Scrolling works using mouse wheel/trackpad and touch scrolling on mobile.
The dialog content remains within the viewport (no content is rendered off-screen without a way to reach it).

file_operations.description: Replace the ScrollArea-based report container with a native overflow scroll region (e.g., a flex child with min-h-0 + overflow-y-auto) to avoid Radix scroll/viewport issues. Ensure the scroll container is the only element that scrolls inside the dialog and that the header/date controls remain visible above it.

Add a small, usage-site CSS utility/class for the Daily Report scroll container to ensure consistent mobile touch scrolling (e.g., -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch and overscroll-behavior: contain), without modifying any files under frontend/src/components/ui/*.

requirements.summary: Restore/keep the end-of-period Summary and ensure its totals equal the sum of the displayed daily totals for the selected range (and hide it for empty results).
acceptanceCriteria: The Daily Report shows a 'Summary' section after the daily breakdown list whenever the report returns data.
Summary totals (meter totals, tip totals, grand total, total owed driver) equal the sum across all included days (days with pickups) for the selected range.
If no days have pickups in the selected range, the UI shows the existing empty state message and does not show a misleading non-zero summary.

file_operations.description: Compute a period summary on the frontend by summing exactly the displayed (filtered) daily totals, and render the Summary section from this computed aggregate. Only show the Summary section when there is at least one displayed day; keep the existing empty-state message when none.

requirements.summary: Update the manual regression checklist to explicitly cover the multi-day Daily Report after import, including scrolling to the end summary.
acceptanceCriteria: The repo includes an updated manual QA checklist (can extend the existing daily report multi-day test) that explicitly verifies: (1) import a file with many pickups across many days, (2) open Daily Report for a range covering those days, (3) confirm multiple day cards render and the list scrolls to the end summary.

file_operations.description: Extend the Daily Report multi-day regression test to explicitly include an import step (many pickups across many days) and a verification step that the Daily Report dialog scrolls to reach the final Summary section on both desktop and mobile.
